manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Phantom Steed must be exiled by Fiend Hunter, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
